resources.string: Before you scan
What a palm scan involves
You will capture your palm from 7 angles. Each angle reveals different line and shape details.
Each photo is quality-checked. If one is blurry or dark, we will coach you to retake it.
Everything is analyzed on your device. Your palm is never used to identify you.
Show me the tips
Lighting and positioning
Three quick tips for a clean scan
Find soft, even light. Avoid direct sun or harsh lamps that cause glare.
Hold your palm flat, fingers slightly apart, filling the on-screen guide.
Keep your hand and phone steady. Rest your elbow on a table if it helps.
Start scanning
